Sam W: Heads-up — domestic partner registration deadline for mid‑year changes is next Friday (5/14). Can someone confirm what docs we need and whether coverage can start retroactive to 5/1? Appreciate any quick guidance :pray:

Jamie (People Ops): Hey Sam — quick note: domestic partner adds are treated as a qualifying life event only if you have a QLE (marriage, birth, loss of other coverage, etc.). If this is a standalone request and no QLE, you usually wait for open enrollment. If you do have a QLE, coverage effective date is typically the first of the month after we process the paperwork. We rarely do retroactive starts to the prior month except in exceptional cases. cc @Ali K (Benefits) to confirm docs and payroll timing.

Ali K (Benefits): Thanks Jamie. Steps for Sam: 1) Complete the Domestic Partner Enrollment form here: https://hr.redwood.com/forms/domestic-partner  2) Upload proof of partnership (see list below)  3) Submit within 30 days of the QLE (if applicable) or by open enrollment otherwise.  Payroll change timeline: changes submitted before the payroll cut (usually the 20th) go into the next pay period; if you miss the cutoff the deduction will start the following cycle.

Ali K (Benefits): Required docs (one item from A and one from B OR two items from C):
```
A - Proof of joint responsibility (choose one): joint lease/mortgage, joint utility bill (within 60 days), joint bank account statement
B - Proof of emotional and financial interdependence (choose one): beneficiary designation, joint insurance policy, affidavit of domestic partnership (signed by both parties)
C - Alternate: two supporting documents like shared mail addressed to both, shared insurance card, or joint tax return
```

Sam W: Got it. If we submit by 5/14 and payroll cutoff is 5/20, then coverage would start on 6/1, correct? Also, do we need notarization for the affidavit?

Ali K (Benefits): Correct — submit by 5/14 and you should be in for 6/1 deductions/coverage. The affidavit doesn't need to be notarized for our internal intake, but some carriers request notarization for eligibility verification; if that happens we'll let you know.

Maya R: FYI — I added the form link to the People Ops handbook page and updated the calendar reminders for the 5/14 deadline. :calendar:

Sam W: Perfect, submitting now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

benefits-bot: Automatic confirmation — we received Sam W's Domestic Partner Enrollment form. Case #8342. Please allow up to 5 business days for verification from the carrier. We'll post updates here when available.

Ali K (Benefits): After the carrier confirms, People Ops will update payroll and benefits enrollment. If carrier asks for notarization or additional docs we'll ping you here.

Sam W: Appreciate it. If anything else is needed I'll upload to the form link.

Jamie (People Ops): Thanks — closing loop. If anyone else is planning a mid‑year add, DM me or drop in #people-ops and we can triage.
